title.en: Amending Presidential Decree No. 894 By Changing the Words "Shipping Lines" to "Vessel" or "Vessels" as the Case May Be

text.en:
Whenever used in Presidential Decree No. 894, the words "shipping lines" are hereby amended
and changed to read as "vessel" or "vessels", as the case may be.

Sections 1, 2, and 3 of Presidential Decree No. 894 are hereby amended or modified accordingly.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 14th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
